caseData.headline: Likely: invoices are fake, inflated or altered

findings.plain: invoices are fake, inflated or altered

signals.explanation: 63 invoice numbers were submitted more than once with different amounts (up to 25.0x the original)
Reported receivables are 15.5x their usual size relative to revenue (2 quarters in a row): money is booked that isn't being collected
6 of 15 invoice documents show a different total from the borrower's data (read twice by the document model)
98 invoices are over 5x what the named customer normally pays
Reported receivables include invoices that S4 found altered, unpaid or implausible
13.9% of invoices past due were never paid by the named customer (108 of 777)
Not enrolled in Setpoint PledgeCheck: whether this collateral is also pledged at other lenders can't be verified
